title: 干细胞与成纤维细胞三维基因组边界探索

source.name: Open2C bundled example data from Krietenstein et al.
source.description: Public multi-resolution Micro-C contact maps for chromosomes 2 and 17 from H1-hESC and HFF cells.

analysis.question: 从胚胎干细胞到成纤维细胞后，染色体接触距离衰减、区室和局部边界是否发生可重复的变化？
analysis.blind_policy: The Agent receives sample identities and file provenance but no paper conclusions, expected loci, boundary counts, or figure targets.
